sections.Intro: This is a very useful remedy in scrofulous conditions, especially in children. It is indicated in skin diseases, such as eczema, especially of the scalp and face. It is also useful in cases of enlarged glands and chronic inflammation of the eyes.
sections.Skin: Eruptions on the scalp and face, with much itching. Scabby eruptions. Crusta lactea.
sections.Eyes: Chronic inflammation of the eyes and eyelids. Phlyctenular conjunctivitis. Scrofular ophthalmia.
sections.Glands: Enlarged glands in the neck and other parts of the body.
